cds.title: University of Southern Indiana Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF; fall 2025 data, the file's pages are headed 2024-2025)

stats.notes: CDS C1 residency breakdown (fall 2025): international 68 applied / 63 admitted / 2 enrolled; 2 more with unknown residency. Only 2 international first-time students enrolled, so USI's first-year international cohort is tiny. The CDS file's pages are headed 'Common Data Set 2024-2025' but report fall 2025 data. GPA distribution is the 'all enrolled' column of C11; the average GPA of 3.42 uses unweighted GPAs only. No early decision or early action; no waitlist; rolling notification.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A/C8F: SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'; students choose whether to submit, and USI superscores.

cost.notes: CDS G1 (first-year): in-state tuition $9,035.70, fees $1,755, food and housing $11,644 (a second column prints fees of $1,240). H6: only institutional NON-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 81 nonresident undergraduates received it (avg $5,225).
